epca.stage.-2: §7The world's barrier is whole here. Nothing is getting through. Not yet.
epca.stage.-1: §7The world's barrier is whole here, but thinner than it looks. Nothing is getting through. Not yet.
epca.stage.0: §eThe world's barrier has loosened. §7After dark, Curbugs crawl through the gaps.
epca.stage.1: §6World Barrier Integrity 90%. §7Rippers have found the way in. Cast a line, and one catch in ten comes up as a Fins.
epca.stage.2: §6World Barrier Integrity 80%. §7The villagers, the herds, the dead and the wolves come back infested, and their severed heads keep walking.
epca.stage.3: §cWorld Barrier Integrity 70%. §7Fins hunt the water. Any creature that dies carrying the Call of the Hive leaves nothing behind.
epca.stage.4: §cWorld Barrier Integrity 60%. §7The Reshaped walk now: Longarms, Yelloweye, and Endermen with the hive inside them. Every fishing catch is lost to the water.
epca.stage.5: §cWorld Barrier Integrity 50%. §7Strike one parasite and every parasite within 32 blocks hears it.
epca.stage.6: §4World Barrier Integrity 40%. §7A fight is now heard 48 blocks away. One in five living things arrives already carrying the Call of the Hive. So might you, each time you respawn or return.
epca.stage.7: §4World Barrier Integrity 30%. §7A fight is heard 64 blocks away. Two in five arrive infected. Of the parasites, only infested Endermen still crawl out of the dark. Every other one was made from something that lived.
epca.stage.8: §4World Barrier Integrity 20%. §7A fight is heard 96 blocks away. Three in five arrive infected. No parasite crawls out of the dark anymore. The hive no longer needs them to: it grows from what it converts.
epca.stage.9: §4World Barrier Integrity 10%. §7A fight is heard 112 blocks away. Nine in ten arrive infected.
epca.stage.10: §4§lWorld Barrier Integrity 1%.§r §7A fight is heard 128 blocks away. Every living thing that enters the world arrives carrying the Call of the Hive. Every one.
epca.stage.11: §5World Barrier Integrity below 1%. §7The Call arrives stronger with every birth. Parasites strike a quarter harder.
epca.stage.12: §5World Barrier Integrity below 1%. §7Parasites strike twice as hard. The hive no longer bothers to hide.
epca.stage.13: §5§lThe world's barrier is gone.§r §7Parasites strike three times as hard, and nothing but parasites will ever spawn again. There is only the hive.
epca.message.stage_too_low: Erosion is below stage 3. The hive will not take root here.
